remarks:
Welcome to 619 6th Street—where everything is brand new! This stunning 4-bedroom, 2-full bath home has been completely rebuilt from the ground up with quality craftsmanship and thoughtful design throughout. Virtually every major component has been replaced, including the roof, furnace, central air conditioning, hot water tank, electrical service, plumbing, drywall, flooring, windows, doors, kitchen, bathrooms, and more. Even the concrete driveway is brand new, providing convenient off-street parking.

The versatile floor plan features a first-floor bedroom and full bathroom, making it ideal for guests, multigenerational living, or a home office, while three additional bedrooms and another beautifully appointed full bath are located upstairs.

Situated in Niagara Falls' highly desirable Short-Term Rental (STR) Zone, this property offers exceptional flexibility for homeowners and investors alike (subject to local regulations and approvals). Whether you're searching for a turnkey primary residence, vacation home, or income-producing opportunity, this property checks every box.

Located just minutes from world-famous Niagara Falls State Park, the Canadian border, the Niagara Scenic Parkway, Seneca Niagara Resort & Casino, fine dining, shopping, entertainment, and countless attractions, this is an incredible opportunity to own a like-new home in one of Western New York's most sought-after locations.

Nothing to do but unpack and enjoy—this is truly a rare find!  All appliances and furniture is included!!
